notes: Expanded to full story set for Clinical Trial Snapshot with no duplicates.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for trial snapshot

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S6.title: Validate Clinical Trial URLs via URL Guardian
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S6.description: Integrate url_guardian to validate and sanitize clinical trial URLs before returning them in snapshot responses, including HEAD check, AI verification, and fallback correction where applicable.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S7.title: Define Clinical Trial Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S7.description: Define a structured response schema for clinical trial snapshots including phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, and URL, aligned with existing Pydantic models and downstream UI expectations.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S8.title: Implement Clinical Trial Snapshot Mapping Logic
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S8.description: Extend clinical_trials_service to map raw ClinicalTrials.gov API responses into the standardized snapshot schema, including extraction of phase, recruitment status, eligibility criteria, locations, and summary text.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S9.title: Expose Clinical Trial Snapshot via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S9.description: Expose the structured clinical trial snapshot through evaluate_care_facade, ensuring compatibility with tool_router and chat response formatting.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S10.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trial Snapshot
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S10.description: Add unit tests for snapshot mapping logic and integration tests covering end-to-end flow from API fetch to facade response, including handling of missing fields and partial data.
